description: Implementation of Recommendations of the Report submitted by the Presidential Commission of Inquiry into the Easter Sunday Attack and the Sectorial Oversight Committee on National Security
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-04-20 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet, at its meeting held 2021.05.17, granted approval for the implementation of the recommendations submitted by the Presidential Commission of Inquiry which was appointed to investigate the Easter Sunday attack and make recommendations to prevent such incidents and the then Sectorial Oversight Committee on National Security. However, since a systematic and robust mechanism has still not been put in place to monitor the practical implementation of those recommendations, there is no methodology to evaluate the progress of implementing those recommendations at present. Therefore, the need to establish a broad organizational structure that prioritizes public and national security has been identified for the successful implementation of those recommendations, and for this purpose, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Defence to appoint a Committee under the supervision of the Presidential Secretariat, comprising of representatives of relevant Ministries and Institutions and an expert in the field of counter-terrorism activities and national security, was approved by the Cabinet.
